note: Edda and Hob's camp under a tree. MOVED 20 Nov 2026 to the starter town (Dave: "place Hob and Edda right in the circle center under the nearest tree with a campfire just like they are now. then move character spawn down next to them"; he picked the Site A plain, town centre x 58160 z 71360, /mnt/project-files/starter-town/SITES.md): the nearest tree to that centre is a summer apple 5.3 m off, 7.0 m tall, shelter circle 2.98 m (tools/npc_camp_spot.gd --x=58160 --z=71360 --bearing=270 --reach=150, Lane B at b0b9494a, 20 Nov 2026). The fire is in front of it on the east side, toward the sea (bearing 270, seen from the east); Hob stands on its south side and Edda sits on its north side, both facing the fire. Before that (Dave 17 Nov 2026: "move EDDA and Hob under the nearest big tree and give them a large campfire that players cannot access and its just inside the shelter line of the tree so the rain doesnt effect it"; he picked the tree beside x 53283 z 68083 and said "put the fire infront of the tree. put hob on the left side of the tree and edda on the right side of the tree both facing the fire"). tree: the foot of the placer tree he picked (tools/npc_camp_spot.gd measures it); no axe, dig or road brings it down. fire: where the camp's large fire burns (wood "log", cooking.json fire_tiers), inside_m inside the tree's rain shelter circle (Cover.crown_radius) on the front side (at the old oak Dave's view bearing 214, front north-north-east; at the apple bearing 270, front east). The old oak was measured on Dave's PC 17 Nov 2026 (tools/npc_camp_spot.gd at 7679152b). The apple is not on the bare-in-winter list (Cover.DECIDUOUS), so it shelters all year; the camp fire burns on whatever the weather. The server keeps it lit and never saves it; no player can feed, light, put out, cook on, open or pick it up; it warms, lights, smokes and keeps wolves off like any large fire. keep_m: nothing is put down (building, station, fire, torch) within this of the tree. Hob's and Edda's spots are the markers.json rows with "npc". PROVISIONAL for Dave (CAMP-1..CAMP-7 in docs/design/NPC_CAMP.md).
